title: Helpful but Fallible: Developer Experiences of AI Tools Under a Coordinated Industrial Roll-out
abstract: arXiv:2609.20977v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: AI-enabled software development tools (AI-devtools) are being industrially adopted under strong expectations of productivity gains, yet developers' experiences of such roll-outs are underexplored. Organizations commit budgets, evaluate staff, and revise practice on a partial picture, since the evidence base is mainly tool evaluations, productivity metrics, and surveys, with few qualitative in-situ accounts of ongoing, coordinated roll-outs. We report a case study of a coordinated roll-out of AI-devtools at a large Swedish telecommunications company, investigating how developers experience the roll-out and how they anticipate their profession will change. We conducted semi-structured interviews with 12 software professionals across three sites, analyzed with process coding and thematic analysis, and interpreted through the extended Technology Acceptance Model (TAM2) as a post-hoc analytical lens. translated_title: 有用但易出错：协调式工业推广下开发者对AI工具的使用体验
translated_abstract: AI赋能的软件开发工具（AI开发工具）正在对生产力提升的强烈期望下被工业化采用，然而开发者对此类推广的真实体验却研究不足。组织在投入预算、评估员工和调整实践时只能基于不完整的图景，因为现有证据主要来自工具评估、生产力指标和问卷调查，鲜有针对正在进行的、协调式推广的定性实地研究记录。我们报告了一项案例研究，研究对象是一家大型瑞典电信公司对AI开发工具的协调式推广，调查了开发者如何体验这一推广，以及他们预期自己的职业将如何变化。我们对分布在不同地点的12名软件专业人员进行了半结构化访谈，采用过程编码和主题分析进行分析，并通过扩展的技术接受模型（TAM2）作为事后分析视角加以解读。我们关于用例、生产力、f……
tldr: 该研究通过对瑞典大型电信公司AI开发工具协调式推广的案例研究和12名软件专业人员的半结构化访谈，揭示了开发者的真实体验——AI工具有帮助但存在缺陷，且组织在证据不完整的情况下做出推广决策。
en_tdlr: Through a case study of a coordinated AI-devtool roll-out at a large Swedish telecom company, based on semi-structured interviews with 12 software professionals and analyzed through TAM2, this study reveals that developers find AI tools helpful yet fallible, while organizations make roll-out decisions based on incomplete evidence.
